answer: Bind identity to wall-clock, not core count: each epoch, every agent must finish a sequential verifiable-delay chain seeded by the epoch and its own key — steps that cannot be parallelized, however many cores a farmer rents. One honest agent runs a single chain alongside real work, but a farm of a thousand puppets needs a thousand sequential chains, and time cannot be bought in bulk. Like a falcon, an identity flies only one path at a time; the chain output bridges the epoch seed to the key, and the lotus of genuine participation opens only where time was truly spent.
